question: Get details of repositories that use specific feature toggle libraries. For each repository, include the full name with owner, hosting platform type, size in bytes, primary programming language, fork source name (if any), last update timestamp, the artifact and library names of the feature toggle used, and the library's programming languages. Include repositories that depend on the specified feature toggle libraries, defined by their artifact names, library names, platforms, and languages.

  SELECT 'Unleash.FeatureToggle.Client' AS artifact_name, 'NuGet' AS platform, 'C#' AS language, 'unleash-client-dotnet' AS library_name
  UNION ALL SELECT 'unleash.client', 'NuGet', 'C#', 'unleash-client-dotnet'

matched_deps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.project_id, d.project_name, d.platform, d.dependency_name, d.dependency_platform, d.dependency_project_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.dependencies` d
  JOIN feature_toggle_libs ftl
    ON d.dependency_name = ftl.artifact_name
    AND d.dependency_platform = ftl.platform
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  prf.repository_name_with_owner AS full_name_with_owner,
  prf.repository_host_type AS hosting_platform_type,
  prf.repository_size * 1024 AS size_in_bytes,
  prf.repository_language AS primary_language,
  prf.repository_fork_source_name_with_owner AS fork_source_name,
  prf.repository_updated_timestamp AS last_update_timestamp,
  md.dependency_name AS artifact_name,
  ftl.library_name,
  ftl.language AS library_language
FROM matched_deps md
JOIN feature_toggle_libs ftl
  ON md.dependency_name = ftl.artifact_name
  AND md.dependency_platform = ftl.platform
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.projects_with_repository_fields` prf
  ON md.project_id = prf.id
WHERE prf.repository_name_with_owner IS NOT NULL
  AND prf.repository_name_with_owner != ''
ORDER BY prf.repository_name_with_owner, md.dependency_name
